story.iWant: I want Toubkal Browser to have a distinct brand identity,
story.soThat: so that I can immediately recognize I'm using Toubkal and not another Chromium-based browser.
story.tasks: - Implement C++ URL scheme registration - Rebrand browser window and basic UI elements - Implement rebranded internal pages - Establish React WebUI foundation for transparency dashboards - Implement Mojo IPC interfaces for dashboard data - Add brand styling and assets

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Browser window displays "Toubkal Browser" in title bar and about dialogs 2. Internal pages (settings, about, version) show Toubkal branding instead of Chromium branding 3. toubkal:// URL scheme is fully functional with auto-redirect from chrome:// URLs 4. Custom Toubkal logo/icon is displayed in browser UI where appropriate 5. No visible "Chromium" or "Chrome" references in internal pages 6. Internal page styling uses Toubkal brand colors and typography 7. React-based transparency dashboard foundation is established for toubkal://audit 8. All internal page URLs use toubkal:// scheme (no chrome:// references)

doc.title: Epic 1.2: Brand Identity & Internal Pages

doc.title: ADR-001: UI Framework Selection
doc.snippet: React 19 + TypeScript 5.5 + Tailwind CSS 4 chosen for internal pages with GN + Vite integration for fast development and type safety.

doc.title: ADR-008: Custom URL Scheme
doc.snippet: Custom toubkal:// scheme registered with auto-redirect from chrome:// URLs for brand identity and backward compatibility.

doc.title: Architecture Overview
doc.snippet: System architecture for URL scheme registration, React WebUI integration, and Mojo IPC communication between browser and UI components.

doc.title: Testing Strategy
doc.section: Unit Testing, Integration Testing, E2E Testing

constraints.constraint: Monolithic Architecture: Follow Chromium's GN + Siso build system patterns with proper BUILD.gn files
WebUI Pattern: Use Chromium's WebUI framework for internal React pages (matches ADR-001)
Mojo IPC: Follow established Mojo patterns for browser ↔ UI communication
URL Scheme: Implement custom scheme registration per ADR-008 specifications
Security: Apply CSP and Trusted Types per ADR-007 for internal page security
Testing Standards: ≥80% coverage for new C++ code, React component coverage, Vitest + gtest frameworks
Code Style: PascalCase classes, snake_case members, Chromium C++ style guide compliance
Path Normalization: Convert absolute paths to project-relative format (strip {project-root} prefix)

tests.standards: Vitest + React Testing Library for TypeScript/React (70% unit, 20% integration, 10% E2E). gtest for C++ unit tests. Playwright for E2E browser automation. 80%+ coverage target for new code. AAA test pattern with proper mocking.
tests.locations: src/**/*.test.ts, src/**/*.test.tsx, src/toubkal/**/test.cc, src/toubkal/**/test.h, e2e/**/*.spec.ts, scripts/check-bundle-size.ts
tests.ideas: - Test toubkal://settings page loads with Toubkal branding (React Testing Library) - Test chrome://settings redirects to toubkal://settings (Playwright E2E) - Test URL scheme registration initializes correctly (C++ gtest) - Test Mojo IPC communication between audit UI and browser backend (integration test) - Test bundle size stays under 200KB gzipped (performance test) - Test CSP headers prevent XSS in internal pages (security test)
